name: 15237 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15237 (Pittsburgh) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15237 (Pittsburgh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
